import sys, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from te.algorithms.formulations.path_based.distributed.coordinator import Coordinator
from te.engine.controller import controller_solve
# cross-check the repaired coordinator against the engine implementation
rng=np.random.default_rng(4)
worst=0
for i in range(2000):
    n=int(rng.integers(1,20))
    X=rng.random(n)*10**float(rng.integers(-1,3))
    rho=float(rng.integers(1,9))
    alpha=float(rng.choice([1.0,0.5,0.75,16/9]))
    mode=str(rng.choice(['route','admit']))
    c=Coordinator(n, rho, alpha)
    z0=rng.normal(0,3,n); u0=rng.normal(0,1,n)
    c._outer_admm_wrapper.record_Z_update(z0); c._outer_admm_wrapper.record_dual_update(u0)
    z,h,t,u=c.step(X, None, mode)
    V=alpha*X+(1-alpha)*z0+u0
    h2,z2,t2=controller_solve(rho, V, mode)
    u2=alpha*X+(1-alpha)*z0+u0-z2
    worst=max(worst, abs(h-h2), float(np.max(np.abs(z-z2))) if n else 0,
              float(np.max(np.abs(t-t2))) if n else 0, float(np.max(np.abs(u-u2))) if n else 0)
print("max discrepancy vs engine controller:", worst)
EOF
